newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria cocoa traders protest over taxes.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria cocoa traders protest over taxes.

text.p: Cocoa traders in the southwestern state of Ondo, which produces two-thirds of Nigeria's cocoa, at the weekend protested to the authorities over the imposition of taxes by members of a state agency.

"Not less than half a million naira has been forcefully collected from us in the last three months without receipts," Gabriel Adewole, deputy chairman of Cocoa Traders Association in Ondo, told a news conference in the state capital Akure.
He said members of the forestry monitoring team set up by the state government had been imposing the taxes on his members.
"Members are not against government collection of revenues as long as it is legal and carried out in a civilised manner," he said.
